answer: Running a farm thus means funding each extra identity through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. Because the age is read from the meadow checkpoint rather than self-declared, the haven audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. An identity must be at least 4 epochs old on the terrace ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. That is 36 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
